title: Блог: Мои Хобби (Продукт)
description: Напиши 3 предложения о том, как долго ты занимался своим хобби до того, как достиг результата.
topic: Напиши 3 предложения о том, как долго ты занимался своим хобби до того, как достиг результата. (I had been playing the guitar for a year before I learned my first song.)

conditions.label: Форма had been + глагол с -ing (3 предложения)
conditions.hint: I had been playing the guitar for a year before I learned my first song.

conditions.label: Маркеры for / since / before
conditions.hint: I had been learning English for 2 years before I passed the test.

conditions.label: Лексика хобби
conditions.hint: playing the guitar, learning English, reading books, drawing

sentences: I had been playing the guitar for six months before I could play my first full song.
I had been learning English for three years before I finally passed my B2 exam.
I had been drawing pictures for two years before I showed my artwork to other people.
